title: Adding Borders to Rows and Columns

blocks.content: Adding Borders to Rows and Columns
To add borders to both the rows and columns, you need to apply the border to the table header (th) and table data (td) cells.
Now, the table has black borders around the cells, making the structure more defined.

blocks.alt: HTML Table with Border and Cell Border

blocks.content: However, the content looks cramped. Next, you'll remove this double border in the table to make the content less cramped and more readable.
